title: Rabbi Chanan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 5b: “Rabbi Chanan said that Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi said that Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said.” In Sanhedrin 8a: “Rabbi Chanan said — and some say Rabbi Shabtai” (referring to Rabbi Elazar’s words). In Berakhot 10b: “Rabbi Chanan said: Even if the master of dreams tells a person that tomorrow he will die, he should not refrain from [praying for] mercy” (referring to the words of Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Elazar).
